marking_points.criterion: Calls Producer with valid Python syntax.
Correct name and region arguments in order.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.

verification.technical: Object instantiated and initialized state asserted.
verification.test_code:
class Producer:
    def __init__(self, name, region):
        self.name = name
        self.region = region
        self.products = []
maker=Producer("Sana Ali","Kenya")
assert (maker.name,maker.region,maker.products)==("Sana Ali","Kenya",[])
